headline: Airbnb Hosts Are Furious They Can No Longer Make Guests Do Their Chores
standfirst: Some hosts are threatening to strike, while others are plotting ways around Airbnb’s new restrictions.
body_markdown:
Some hosts are threatening to strike, while others are plotting ways around Airbnb’s new restrictions. Guests, meanwhile, are celebrating. (Wired)

**The Verge** adds: Checking out of your next Airbnb might be less of a hassle now that the company is banning hosts from including time-consuming chores in their house rules. Airbnb's updated house rules policy, which starts with reservations booked on or after November 20th, says hosts can't ask guests to "complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner." According to Airbnb, that includes: Dishes: Guests shouldn't be asked to wash and put away dishes, but you can ask them to put used dishes in the sink.

**BBC News US & Canada** adds: The updated policy will apply to all reservations booked on the accommodation site on or after 20 November.

**Engadget** adds: Any chores that a cleaner might do are no longer deemed reasonable requests for visitors.

**MyJoyOnline** adds: Airbnb has changed its rules to limit what property hosts can ask guests to do—including cleaning. The updated guidelines say hosts can now set seven standard house rules and add other “reasonable” requests.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by MyJoyOnline, BBC News US & Canada, Engadget, Wired and The Verge. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
